messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Private-VPC ILB cross-region routing errors detected — 8.4% error rate for EU->US inter-region flows over last 5m. Auto-escalate ON. Paging oncall.

alex (oncall): I'm awake, grabbing context. Which customers?

maria (sre): i'm checking the ILB healthmaps now. Seeing many flows hitting 503/NoRoute across eu-west1 -> us-central1.

chris (networking): curious if this is route translation TTL regen churn. saw similar with route table rebuilds during GCP control-plane idx updates.

alex (oncall): good call. Running quick traceroute from an affected private instance:
```
traceroute to 10.130.22.45 (10.130.22.45), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.128.0.1 (10.128.0.1)  0.7 ms  0.6 ms  0.6 ms
 2  10.142.0.1 (10.142.0.1)  1.1 ms  1.0 ms  1.0 ms
 3  * * *
```
Looks like next-hop not resolving after hop 2. Could be ILB frontend translation flapping.

maria (sre): checking control-plane logs for ilb config syncs. Querying our control plane audit: 
`SELECT * FROM lb_sync_events WHERE region='eu-west1' AND time > now() - interval '10 minutes'`
Got repeated 503s from GCP API at 1951239400 -> rate-limited POST to global/forwardingRules apply.

chris (networking): I can see correlation in GCP VPC route table change events: several route translations got regenerated ~1951239420. Could be control-plane bitrot + GCP API transient auth errors.

alex (oncall): Did we hit our own rate limits or is it upstream? Any clues from the GCP auth proxy logs?

maria (sre): our control-plane auth proxy shows 429s from GCP: `401/429 from iam.googleapis.com` around same window. GCP support ticket inbound.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-195123 — severity: high. Notifying oncall escalation policy.

jess (pm): are customers seeing dropped requests or just degraded latency? need an early blurb for support.

alex (oncall): early impact: cross-region traffic between EU PrivateVPC tenants and US endpoints is getting 503/no route. Internal estimate: ~18 tenants intermittently impacted, ~12% of cross-region traffic. I'll put a status note once verified.

chris (networking): temporary mitigation: we can try pinning affected flows to regional ILB variant in eu-west1 to avoid cross-region route translation for those customers. That requires flipping a routing policy on the tenant config (fast, reversible).

maria (sre): steps to pin: update tenant-routing policy -> set prefer_regional_ilb=true -> push config -> warm cache. I can run the change for 3 high-affected tenants as a canary.

alex (oncall): Do it. For canary pick tenant-42, tenant-87, tenant-310. Inform support and engineering. Also enable extra debug logs for 5m.

maria (sre): executing now. 
```
# config API call (internal)
PATCH /v1/tenants/tenant-42/routing { "prefer_regional_ilb": true }
```
Push done for three tenants at 1951239801. Monitoring.

chris (networking): after the change, traceroute from tenant-42 shows path preserved to regional ILB, no * hops. Error rate for those tenants dropped to 0.6% within 90s.

alex (oncall): good signal. Continue rolling to other high-impact tenants. Meanwhile GCP ticket updated: gcp-support-bot: CASE-987654 created, assigned to networking infra team.

gcp-support-bot: GCP support message: Investigating control-plane auth proxy 429s — internal rollout causing transient token refresh failures in some regions. ETA 40-60m for full remediation.

jess (pm): escalation note: we should prepare a customer-facing message. summary: cross-region PrivateVPC traffic may see failures; mitigation: we pinned flows to regional ILBs for affected customers; full fix depends on GCP rollout.

alex (oncall): drafting support note and internal timeline. Anyone have quick numbers for affected traffic volume?

maria (sre): from metrics: cross-region outgoing tokens from eu-west1 to us-central1 dropped 12% success -> estimate 4.3M tokens / hr impacted at peak. I'll add to the summary.

chris (networking): long-term mitigation ideas: fallback routing to regional-only path option, exponential backoff + queueing in our control-plane when upstream returns 429, and local control-plane caching of forwarding rule translations with TTL extension.

alex (oncall): agree. For now continue pin rollout to the rest of the 18 tenants. Maria proceed with bulk script but do 5 at a time with 30s gap. Post result here.

maria (sre): bulk rollout started at 1951240500. Progress: 5/18 applied -> success for those -> error rate down 55% overall.

gcp-support-bot: Support update: GCP has applied a regional patch and 429s are decreasing; tokens refreshed. They'll continue validating; please keep monitoring for 30m.

alex (oncall): starting handoff to night shift in 45m. I'll leave runbook note and current mitigation state. Maria, please take primary for overnight monitoring.

maria (sre): will do. Handoff notes: mitigation = pinned affected tenants to regional ILB; bulk rollout 18 tenants complete at 1951241100; observed global error rate down from 8.4% -> 1.1%. GCP support: rolling remediation in progress.

chris (networking): follow-up action for postmortem: add graceful fallback path in routing logic, increase control-plane API retry/backoff, instrument per-tenant ILB affinity as a knob.

alex (oncall): inc status update sent to #customer-facing-status. Jesse, attach the numbers and note we're monitoring and working with GCP.

jess (pm): copying the incident post to support portal and scheduled a customer sync for affected enterprise tenants. thanks team. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident INC-195123 updated: status = mitigating, severity = high, owner = maria (sre).

alex (oncall): handing off fully to maria at 1951241600. I'm reachable if escalation needed.

maria (sre): acknowledged, taking over. Will keep this channel updated.
